summary.text: Glenn Wakai began a television news career in 1991 as a reporter and anchor in Guam and Saipan, and later worked for KHON-FOX2 and KHNL NBC 8.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Hawaii House of Representatives in November 2002 and later served in the Hawaii State Senate.

According to the legislative biography, Wakai is president of the public relations firm High Impact Communications, runs the nonprofit Reach out Pacific, and graduated from Mid-Pacific Institute and the University of Southern California.
